name: Veil-ian #14
description: A veiled figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Feather crest. Aperture: Woven band. Ornament: Waves. Palette: Bone + teal. Hem: Ragged. Its palette is the only one of its kind in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
